name: MEC E Open House Booth
shortDescription: Start your visit at the Mechanical Engineering booth in the Open House booth fair.

name: MEC E Program Presentation
shortDescription: Hear from the department about the Mechanical Engineering program.

name: Tour Start – West Entry
shortDescription: Begin the MEC E building tour at the second-floor west entry.

name: Undergraduate Design Courses
shortDescription: See projects from the undergraduate mechanical design courses.

name: Autonomous Robotic Vehicle Project (ARVP)
shortDescription: A multidisciplinary team that designs, builds, and tests autonomous underwater vehicles for the international RoboSub Competition.

name: EcoCar
shortDescription: A student-run team that designs and builds ultra-efficient hydrogen fuel cell vehicles for the Shell Eco-Marathon.

name: UAlberta Formula Racing
shortDescription: A student team that designs, builds, tests, and races a Formula-style car at SAE's international collegiate competition.

name: MEC E 403 – Mechanical Engineering Laboratory II
shortDescription: Step inside a senior undergraduate lab and see the experiments students run.

name: Dean's Research Awards and Capstone Projects
shortDescription: Explore undergraduate research and final-year capstone design projects.

name: AlbertaSat
shortDescription: A student team that designs, builds, and operates CubeSat satellites, with two already launched.

name: Student Team for Alberta Rocketry Research
shortDescription: A student team competing in intercollegiate rocketry with its own airframes, avionics, and liquid rocket engines.

name: Engineers for a Sustainable World
shortDescription: A student group building sustainability-focused projects that make an impact around the university community.

name: Mechanical Engineering Club
shortDescription: The student community for MEC E: social and industry events, intramurals, snacks, and printing.

name: MEC E 301 – Mechanical Engineering Laboratory I
shortDescription: Watch live demonstrations from the first mechanical engineering lab course.
